database_note:
The salesorderheader and salesorderdetail tables record transactions. Salesorderheader tracks order headers, while salesorderdetail stores individual line items. The salesperson table records employee details, and salespersonquotahistory tracks their quota changes over time. The salesterritory table defines sales regions.

Lookup tables include product, productcategory, productsubcategory, productdescription, productmodelproductdescriptionculture, currencyrate, countryregioncurrency, and productreview.

Connect the main tables as follows: salesorderheader joins to salesorderdetail on salesorderid. Salesorderheader links to salesperson via salespersonid matching businessentityid. Salesorderheader connects to salesterritory using territoryid. Salesperson also links to salesterritory via territoryid. Salesorderheader references currencyrate through currencyrateid. Product details connect via productid in salesorderdetail. Product hierarchy links product to productsubcategory via productsubcategoryid, and productsubcategory to productcategory via productcategoryid.
